items.heading: Waking up before sunrise (Brahma Muhurta) and morning sunlight exposure
details: The pre-dawn hours are typically quiet, making them ideal for focused study, exercise, or meditation.
Bright morning light exposure helps synchronize the body's internal clock and mood through the day.

items.heading: Sun-drying clothes
details: Heat and sunlight promote drying and can reduce some microorganisms on fabric.

items.heading: Sun-drying medicinal herbs
details: Reduces moisture in harvested herbs, permitting much longer storage without spoilage.

items.heading: Not sleeping with the head towards the north
details: One traditional explanation draws a parallel between the body's own field and the earth's magnetic field.
Whatever the underlying reason, keeping a fixed sleeping orientation is linked with more consistent sleep habits.
